title: Private Console — Network Change Simulator & Operator Handoff
creator: Asha Menon
description: Design and prototype a Network Change Simulator in the Private Console that allows operators and customers to preview the impact of planned network or cluster changes. The simulator should produce a summarized operator handoff (runbook) and an interactive visualization of affected VPC peering, subnet routes, egress paths, and dependent clusters. Goal: reduce rollout surprises during Private/VPC upgrades by giving SREs and tenant admins a reproducible preview with cost and latency delta estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype (Figma) that simulates: topology delta, traffic paths, and failover scenario walkthroughs
Runbook generator output that lists steps, affected tenants, expected impact windows, and rollback commands in plain text
Design validated in a 1-hour review with Infra, SRE, and Security with explicit list of uncovered telemetry needs
Usability test with at least 3 internal operators showing that simulator reduces ambiguous handoff notes
Contains microcopy for safety warnings and suggested pre-checks (permissions, KMS, firewall)
comments: 2026-02-25 - Asha Menon: Initial ticket created after operator workshop. Core ask: preview cluster-level network changes and produce a deterministic handoff for maintenance windows.

2026-02-28 - Liam O'Connor: Sketched three flows — 'dry-run topology', 'simulated traffic replay', and 'failure walkthrough'. Need product to prioritize one MVP flow. Recommend starting with dry-run topology + runbook output.

2026-03-02 - Review (Infra): Prefer simulated traffic to rely only on metrics and flow logs, not synthetic packets. Trade-off: fidelity vs privacy; we should expose a 'model confidence' metric instead of raw packet replay.

2026-03-04 - Security feedback: No synthetic traffic that leaves customer VPC. Simulator must run against anonymized flow-logs or a generated synthetic dataset. Also require clear opt-in toggle and audit event for simulator runs.

2026-03-06 - Design review: High-fidelity frames added for the topology diff panel, detail flyout for affected routes, and a cost-impact quick estimate card. Asked to add an 'impact severity' color scale and inline explanation.
2026-03-08 - Usability note (Solutions Eng): Operators want an 'export to incident' button that creates a pre-filled incident with steps and affected clusters. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-10 - PM alignment (Ravi Patel): Approve MVP scope: Dry-run topology + runbook generator + safety copy + telemetry spec. Defer traffic replay to future cycle. Next: SRE technical spike to identify required logs and permission surface.
